           JUSTICIA ADHATODA

         An Indian Shrub, Singhee

        (JUSTICIA ADHATODA BASAKA)


Highly efficacious medicine for acute catarrhal conditions of the
        respiratory tract (used in the beginning)



Head.--  Irritable, sensitive to external impressions; hot, full
        and heavy head; lachrymation, with   coryza, profuse  ,
        fluent, with constant sneezing; loss of smell and taste;   coryza
        with cough  .



Throat.--  Dry, pain during empty swallowing, tenacious mucus.
        Mouth dry.



Respiratory.--  Dry cough from sternal region all over chest.
        Hoarseness, larynx painful.   Paroxysmal cough  , with
        suffocative obstruction of respiration.   Cough with sneezing  .
        Severe dyspnœa with cough.   Tightness across chest  .
        Asthmatic attacks, cannot endure a close, warm room.   Whooping-cough  .



Relationship.--  Seems to come between   Cepa
        and   Euphrasia  , which compare.



Dose.--  Third potency and higher. Severe aggravation have been
        noticed from lower potencies.
